dedupe_keys.name: clia global map of ports with onshore power supply for cruise ships march 2024

description: A one-page global map from the Cruise Lines International Association listing ports with at least one cruise berth equipped with onshore power supply (shore power), from its own port analysis. Contents: 34 ports with active shore power, 23 funded and 16 planned, each named by country, for example Juneau, Seattle, Vancouver, Brooklyn, Hamburg, Kiel, Rotterdam, Bergen, Southampton, Barcelona, Genoa, Piraeus, Shanghai and Sydney, with a note that plugging in can cut ship emissions in port by up to 98 percent depending on the energy mix. Coverage: cruise ports worldwide, status as of 1 March 2024. Format and access: a free PDF map. Licence and cost: free to download; no licence is stated. Caveats: it covers cruise berths only, gives no capacities, voltages or usage and is a snapshot that will date. Useful for capacity planning of port electricity demand and grid connections, where shore power berths add large, schedulable loads to local networks. It relates to the ICCT study of shore power needs at EU ports in the catalogue.
